abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess the results of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) of residual masses in patients with disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumour treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, both in terms of extension of surgery, morbidity and survival. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Retrospectively, all patients treated for non-seminomatous germ cell tumour at the University Hospital of Antwerp were studied from January 1987 till December 1997. In patients with non-seminomatous testicular cancer more than stage I, the 'wait and see' strategy changed and patients were treated with chemotherapy. Patients were assessed at the end of chemotherapy and if a residual masses persisted, a RPLND was performed. If possible, a nerve-sparing lymphadenectomy was performed. Extension of surgery, morbidity and survival were analysed. RESULTS: Sixty patients had a non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis and were analysed. The median follow-up was 78 months (range: 13-144 months). Thirteen patients with stage I disease were treated with orchiectomy only and none of these patients had recurrent disease. Forty-seven patients were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. A complete response was observed in sixteen patients (34%), while 31 patients (66%) achieved a partial response and were treated with a RPLND. Fifteen patients underwent RPLND above the level of the renal trunk. In two patients malignant cells or fibrotic tissue were found above the renal trunk and bilateral. In five patients viable tumour cells were found in the region below the renal trunk. Sixteen patients underwent RPLND below the level of the renal trunk, of which nine had a unilateral resection, containing viable tumour in two patients. Operative mortality was 0%. One patient died six months after RPLND due to metastatic disease. In two patients, an important retroperitoneal bleeding occurred. Resection of adherent organs was performed in two patients. Long term sexual problems were reported by thirteen patients (65%) with bilateral lymphadenectomy versus two patients (18%) in the unilateral group. The survival of the patients treated with a RPLND was 97% and in the whole group of patients with a non-seminomatous testicular cancer 98%. CONCLUSION: RPLND has a place in the treatment of patients with non-seminomatous testicular cancer after chemotherapy in case of residual masses. Although mortality is low, morbidity is acceptable. In a limited number of patients there was a need of resection of adherent organs when a resection above the renal trunk was performed.
abstract_ja: 目的：播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して、シスプラチン併用化学療法を施行後に残存腫瘤を認めた患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の成績を、手術の範囲、合併症、生存の観点から評価すること。患者と方法：後方視的に、1987年1月から1997年12月までにアントワープ大学病院で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療を受けた全患者を調べた。病期I超の非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者では、「経過観察」戦略を変更し、化学療法を施行した。化学療法終了時に評価を行い、残存腫瘤が持続する場合にはRPLNDを施行した。可能な限り神経温存リンパ節郭清を施行した。手術の範囲、合併症、生存を解析した。結果：精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍60例を解析した。中央値の追跡期間は78か月(範囲：13～144か月)であった。病期I疾患の13例は精巣摘除術のみで治療し、これらの患者にはいずれも再発はみられなかった。47例はシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療した。16例(34%)で完全奏効が得られ、31例(66%)は部分奏効となり、RPLNDを施行した。15例は腎静脈分岐部より上方でRPLNDを施行された。2例では腎静脈分岐部より上方の両側に悪性細胞または線維化組織が認められた。5例では腎静脈分岐部より下方の領域に生存腫瘍細胞が認められた。16例は腎静脈分岐部より下方でRPLNDを施行され、そのうち9例は片側切除で、2例に生存腫瘍が含まれていた。手術死亡率は0%であった。1例はRPLND後6か月で転移性疾患により死亡した。2例で後腹膜に重大な出血が生じた。2例では接着臓器の切除を施行した。両側リンパ節郭清を受けた13例(65%)と片側群の2例(18%)で長期の性機能障害が報告された。RPLNDを施行された患者の生存率は97%、非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者全体では98%であった。結論：RPLNDは、化学療法後に残存腫瘤がある非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者の治療において意義を有する。死亡率は低く、合併症も許容可能である。腎静脈分岐部より上方の切除を行った場合、少数の患者では接着臓器の切除が必要であった。
